ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe features a distal high-intensity white patch bordered by a black leading edge. Right lobe contains a large central white field with dark vertical mottling, encapsulated by a thick black perimeter on the trailing and lateral edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks (up to 12 pixels) compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory on both lobes, tapering to acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both lobes and along the upper trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions observed within the white pigmentation zone of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of white textural anomalies (barnacles) forming a jagged irregular border on the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical 'barcode' style pigmentation marks located within the primary white patch of the right lobe.
